# Introduction:

Our Hyper-Local Shipment API empowers businesses to efficiently manage and track deliveries within localized regions, ensuring fast and reliable service tailored to the needs of their communities.

Designed for rapid delivery within short distances, the Hyper-Local Shipment API enables seamless coordination of shipments in densely populated or geographically compact areas.

The Hyper-Local Shipment API provides a robust solution for managing deliveries in urban or localized environments, optimizing routes and ensuring quick turnarounds for end-users.

With the Hyper-Local Shipment API, businesses can streamline their last-mile logistics, offering customers faster, more predictable delivery times within specific neighborhoods or local zones.

![][image1]

1. #  **Authentication** 

Use this authentication api to generate the token for the external users. Use this token in the header of all the apis. If the token expires. You need to generate it again with the same credentials. To generate the token you need to create an external user from the shiprocket panel. 

Here is the URL to add external users : [https://app.shiprocket.in/seller/settings/additional-settings/api-users](https://app.shiprocket.in/seller/settings/additional-settings/api-users)

Once you create an external User, use the external user email and password to generate the token with the below endpoints. 

**Note :: The token is valid for 10 days, post which you will have to regenerate the token.**

End Point : https://apiv2.shiprocket.in/v1/external/auth/login

Method : POST

### **Sample Curl Request**

    curl 	\--location 'https://apiv2.shiprocket.in/v1/external/auth/login' \\  
\--header 'Content-Type: application/json' \\  
\--data-raw '{  
    		"email": "\<External User email\>",  
    		"password": "\<External user password\>"  
}'

### **Request Headers**

* ### `Content-Type`: `application/json`

### **Request Parameters**

| Name | Data type | Description | Required |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| email | *String* | API user email | Yes |
| password | *String* | API user password | Yes |

### **Example Success Response**

 {  
  	"company\_id":  \<Shiprocket Company ID\>,  
  	"created\_at": "2024-08-09 10:53:36",  
  	"email": "\<External User email id\>",  
  	"first\_name": "dummy first name",  
  	"id": dummy\_id,  
 	"last\_name": “dummy Last Name",  
  	"token": "\<External API Token\>"  
}

### **Response Parameters**

| Name | Data type | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| company\_id | *Integer* | Shiprocket Company ID |
| created\_at | *String* | User Created date |
| ?email | *String* | Login User Email address |
| first\_name | *String* | Login user First Name |
| id | *integer* | ID of the user |
| last\_name | *String* | Login user Last Name |
| token | *String* | Unique access token which you need to use in all the apis to communicate |

2. # Serviceability

This API endpoint is used to check the serviceability of a courier based on specific shipping details, such as Delivery and pickup postcodes, Latitude , Longitude, and other parameters. It returns a list of available courier services along with their respective rates.

**Note : Geo Coordinate is mandatory to get the serviceable couriers for Hyperlocal shipments.** 

End Point : [https://apiv2.shiprocket.in/v1/external/courier/serviceability](https://apiv2.shiprocket.in/v1/external/courier/serviceability)

Method : GET 

### **Sample Curl Request**

   curl \--location    
'https://apiv2.shiprocket.in/v1/external/courier/serviceability?delivery\_postcode=122002\&pickup\_postcode=122008\&is\_new\_hyperlocal=1\&lat\_from=28.509223937988\&long\_from=77.067848205566\&lat\_to=28.50724220275879\&long\_to=77.06745147705078' \\  
\--header 'Content-Type: application/json' \\  
\--header 'Authorization: Bearer {{token}}'

Note: For SPMD (Single Pickup Multiple Drops) Serviceability

Changes in the serviceability: add comma( , ) separated lat\_to and long\_to (as per the numbers of drops ) in the URL parameter.

**Sample SPMD CURL Request** 

curl \--location  

'https://apiv2.shiprocket.in/v1/external/courier/serviceability?delivery\_postcode=122002\&pickup\_postcode=122008\&is\_new\_hyperlocal=1\&lat\_from=28.509223937988\&long\_from=77.067848205566\&lat\_to=*28.50724220275879,28.50723449934\&lat\_to=77.06745147705078,77.10745147705078*' \\

\--header 'Content-Type: application/json' \\  
\--header 'Authorization: Bearer {{token}}'

### **Request Headers**

* `Content-Type` : `application/json`  
* `Authorization` : `Bearer {{token}}`  
  * Replace `{{token}}` with the actual bearer token received after authentication.

**Request Parameters**

The following request parameters must be included in the request URL:

| Parameter | Type | Description | Required |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| pickup\_postcode | *string* | The postal code where the shipment will be picked up. (Warehouse Postal Codes) 122001 | Yes |
| lat\_from | *float* | Pickup Latitude. Mandatory in case of Hyper local shipments | Yes |
| long\_from | *float* | Pickup Longitude. Mandatory in case of Hyper local shipments | Yes  |
| delivery\_postcode | *string* | The postal code where the shipment will be delivered (Customer Postal Codes) 122001 | Yes |
| lat\_to | *float* | Delivery Latitude. Mandatory in case of Hyper local shipments | Yes |
| long\_to | *float* | Delivery Longitude. Mandatory in case of Hyper local shipments | Yes |
| is\_new\_hyperlocal | *integer* | Indicates whether the service is a new hyperlocal (1 for yes). This is mandatory to send. | Yes  |
| mode\_of\_transport | *integer* | Indicates mode\_of\_transport: 2/3/4 | In case of 3 or 4 Wheeler |

### **Example Success Response**

{  
  	"status": true,  
  	"data": \[{  
      			"courier\_name": "Shiprocket Quick",  
      			"rates": 345.3,  
			"distance": 3.5,  
   	 }\]  
}

### **Response Parameters**

| Field | Type | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| status | *boolean* | Indicates whether the request was successful (true) or not (false). |
| data | *array* | An array of available courier options. |
| courier\_name | *string* | Name of the available courier service. |
| rates | *Float* | Cost associated with using the courier service. |

3. # Pickup Address

This API endpoint is used to add a new pickup location to your Shiprocket account. It requires details about the pickup location, including the address, contact information, and other relevant data.

## Endpoint :  https://apiv2.shiprocket.in/v1/external/settings/company/addpickup

Method : POST 

### **Sample Curl Request**

curl   
\--location 'https://apiv2.shiprocket.in/v1/external/settings/company/addpickup' \\  
\--header 'Content-Type: application/json' \\  
\--header 'Authorization: Bearer {{token}}' \\  
\--data-raw '{  
		"pickup\_location": "Home",  
		"name": "Deadpool",  
		"email": "deadpool@chimichanga.com",  
		"phone": "9777777779",  
		"address": "Mutant Facility, Sector 3",  
		"address\_2": "",  
		"city": "Pune",  
		"state": "Maharshtra",  
		"country": "India",  
		"pin\_code": "110022",  
		"lat" : "28.509223937988",  
		"long": "77.067848205566",  
		"is\_hyperlocal": 1,  
}'

### **Request Headers**

* `Content-Type` : `application/json`  
* `Authorization` : `Bearer {{token}}`  
  * Replace `{{token}}` with the actual bearer token received after authentication.

### **Request Parameters**

The request body should be sent in JSON format and must contain the following fields:

| Field | Type | Description | Required |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| pickup\_location | *string* | The name of the pickup location (e.g., "Home"). | Yes |
| name | *string* | The name of the contact person at the pickup location. | Yes |
| email | *string* | The email address of the contact person. | Yes |
| phone | *string* | The phone number of the contact person. | Yes |
| address | *string* | The primary address of the pickup location.  **Minimum 10 characters.** | Yes |
| address\_2 | *string* | Additional address details (optional). | No |
| city | *string* | The city where the pickup location is located. | Yes |
| state | *string* | The state where the pickup location is located. | Yes |
| country | *string* | The country where the pickup location is located. | Yes |
| pin\_code | *string* | The postal code of the pickup location. | Yes |
| lat | *float* | Pickup Latitude. Mandatory in case of Hyper local shipments | Yes |
| long | *float* | Pickup Longitude. Mandatory in case of Hyper local shipments | Yes |

### **Example Success Response**

"success": true,

### **Response Parameters**

| Field | Type | Description |
| ----- | ----- | :---- |
| company\_id | *integer* | The unique ID of the company. |
| pickup\_code | *string* | The code assigned to the pickup location. |
| address | *string* | The primary address of the pickup location. |
| address\_2 | *string* | Additional address details. |
| address\_type | *string* | Type of the address (e.g., residential, commercial). |
| city | *string* | The city where the pickup location is located. |
| state | *string* | The state where the pickup location is located. |
| country | *string* | The country where the pickup location is located. |
| gstin | *string* | The GSTIN (Goods and Services Tax Identification Number), if applicable. |
| pin\_code | *string* | The postal code of the pickup location. |
| phone | *string* | The phone number associated with the pickup location. |
| email | *string* | The email address associated with the pickup location. |
| name | *string* | The name of the contact person. |
| alternate\_phone | *string* | Alternate phone number (if any). |
| lat | *string* | Latitude of the pickup location (if available). |
| long | *string* | Longitude of the pickup location (if available). |
| status | *integer* | The status of the pickup location (e.g., active, inactive). |
| phone\_verified | *integer* | Indicates if the phone number is verified (0 for no, 1 for yes). |
| rto\_address\_id | *integer* | The ID associated with the Return To Origin (RTO) address, if applicable. |
| extra\_info | *string* | Additional information about the pickup location. |
| updated\_at | *string* | The timestamp when the pickup location was last updated. |
| created\_at | *string* | The timestamp when the pickup location was created. |
| id | *integer* | The unique ID assigned to the pickup location. |

4. # Order creation

This API endpoint is used to create an ad-hoc order in the Shiprocket system. It allows you to specify billing and shipping details, order items, payment method, and other related details for the order. The order is then added to the Shiprocket platform, where it can be processed for shipment. 

## Endpoint : [https://apiv2.shiprocket.in/v1/external/orders/create/adhoc](https://apiv2.shiprocket.in/v1/external/orders/create/adhoc)

## Method : POST 

### **Sample Curl Request**

curl   
\--location 'https://apiv2.shiprocket.in/v1/external/orders/create/adhoc' \\  
\--header 'Content-Type: application/json' \\  
\--header 'Authorization: Bearer {{token}}' \\  
\--data-raw '{  
  	"order\_id": "224-447",  
  	"order\_date": "2019-07-24 11:11",  
  	"pickup\_location": "TESTADI",  
  	"billing\_customer\_name": "Naruto",  
  	"billing\_last\_name": "Uzumaki",  
  	"billing\_address": "House 221B, Leaf Village",  
  	"billing\_address\_2": "Near Hokage House",  
  	"billing\_city": "New Delhi",  
  	"billing\_pincode": "110002",  
  	"billing\_state": "Delhi",  
  	"billing\_country": "India",  
  	"billing\_email": "naruto@uzumaki.com",  
  	"billing\_phone": "9876543210",  
  	"shipping\_is\_billing": true,  
  	"order\_items": \[{  
      		"name": "Kunai",  
		"category\_name": "Food",  
      		"sku": "chakra123",  
      		"units": 10,  
      		"selling\_price": "900",  
      		"hsn": 441122  
    	}\],  
  	"payment\_method": "Prepaid",  
  	"length": 10,  
  	"breadth": 15,  
  	"height": 20,  
  	"weight": 2.5,  
           "sub\_total" : 9000,  
           "collect\_shipping\_fees": false,  
	"shipping\_method" : "HL",  
	"latitude" : "28.509223937988",  
	"longitude"’ : "77.067848205566",  
	“pickup\_otp” :”1234”,  
	“drop\_otp”: “5678”,  
	“rto\_otp”: “9123”  
		“expected\_edd”: “20”  
}'	

### **Request Headers**

* `Content-Type` : `application/json`  
* `Authorization` : `Bearer {{token}}`  
  * Replace `{{token}}` with the actual bearer token received after authentication.

### **Request Parameters**

The request body should be sent in JSON format and must contain the following fields:

| Field | Type | Description | Required |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| order\_id | *string* | The unique identifier for the order. | Yes |
| order\_date | *string* | The date and time when the order was placed, in YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM format. | Yes |
| pickup\_location | *string* | The location from where the order will be picked up. This is what you get from the add pickup location api. | Yes |
| billing\_customer\_name | *string* | The first name of the billing customer. | Yes |
| billing\_last\_name | *string* | The last name of the billing customer. | No |
| billing\_address | *string* | The primary address of the billing customer. | Yes |
| billing\_address\_2 | *string* | Additional address details for the billing customer. | No |
| billing\_city | *string* | The city of the billing customer. | Yes |
| billing\_pincode | *string* | The postal code of the billing customer. | Yes |
| billing\_state | *string* | The state of the billing customer. | No |
| billing\_country | *string* | The country of the billing customer. | Yes |
| billing\_email | *string* | The email address of the billing customer. | No |
| billing\_phone | *string* | The phone number of the billing customer. | Yes |
| latitude | *float* | Delivery Longitude. Mandatory in case of Hyper local shipments | Yes |
| longitude | *float* | Delivery Longitude. Mandatory in case of Hyper local shipments | Yes |
| shipping\_is\_billing | *boolean* | Indicates if the shipping address is the same as the billing address. | Yes |
| shipping\_customer\_name | string | The first name of the shipping customer (if different from billing). | Conditional Yes |
| shipping\_last\_name | string | The last name of the shipping customer (if different from billing). | Conditional Yes |
| shipping\_address | string | The primary address of the shipping customer (if different from billing). | Conditional Yes |
| shipping\_address\_2 | string | Additional address details for the shipping customer. | Conditional Yes |
| shipping\_city | string | The city of the shipping customer (if different from billing). | Conditional Yes |
| shipping\_pincode | string | The postal code of the shipping customer (if different from billing). | Conditional Yes |
| shipping\_country | string | The country of the shipping customer (if different from billing). | Conditional Yes |
| shipping\_state | string | The state of the shipping customer (if different from billing). | Conditional Yes |
| shipping\_email | string | The email address of the shipping customer (if different from billing). | Conditional Yes |
| shipping\_phone | string | The phone number of the shipping customer (if different from billing). | Conditional Yes |
| order\_items | *array* | An array of items in the order. Each item should have the fields: name, sku, units, selling\_price, hsn, [**category\_name\*\***](#**-notes:-category-name-under-order_items-is-mandatory-and-values-should-be-from-the-below-list). | Yes |
| payment\_method | *string* | The payment method used for the order (e.g., Prepaid). HL is supporting only Prepaid / cod for now. *In case of COD **sub\_total** would not be greater than Rs. 2000\.* | Yes |
| sub\_total | *integer* | The subtotal amount for the order, before any additional charges. | Yes |
| length | *float* | The length of the package in centimeters. | Yes |
| breadth | *float* | The width of the package in centimeters. | Yes |
| height | *float* | The height of the package in centimeters. | Yes |
| weight | *float* | The weight of the package in kilograms. | Yes |
| shipping\_method | *string* | Shipping method use HL in case of Hyper local shipments | Yes |
| drop\_otp | *int* | Drop OTP on the rider app to verify the OTP. It should be only **4 digit** value | No |
| rto\_otp | *int* | RTO OTP on the rider app to verify the OTP. It should be only **4 digit** value | No  |
| search\_rider\_for | int | The duration or interval before actively searching for a rider. It should be in sec. Max value is **1800** seconds | No |
| collect\_shipping\_fees | *boolean* | Freight value to be collected from the buyer during delivery. | No |
| is\_insurance\_opt | *boolean* | Secure your shipment. [TnC](https://sr-cdn-1.shiprocket.in/pdf/SR-Hyperlocal.pdf%20) | No |
| pickup\_otp | *int* | Pickup OTP on the rider app to verify the OTP. It should be only **4 digit** value | No |
| surge\_type | *String* | This is Surge Type , eg, Rain / Festive / Etc | No |
| surge\_fees | *Float* | This will be the fees. Its in float | No |

### **Example Success Response**

{  
  	"order\_id": 16161616,  
  	"shipment\_id": 15151515,  
  	"status": "NEW",  
  	"status\_code": 1  
}

### **Response Parameters**

The API response will be in JSON format and may contain the following fields:

| Field | Type | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| order\_id | integer | The unique identifier for the order created in the Shiprocket system. |
| shipment\_id | integer | The unique identifier for the shipment associated with the order. |
| status | string | The status of the order (e.g., NEW). |
| status\_code | integer | A numeric code representing the status of the order. |

### \*\* Notes:  Category name under order\_items is **MANDATORY** and values should be from the below list {#**-notes:-category-name-under-order_items-is-mandatory-and-values-should-be-from-the-below-list}

- Electronics  
- Clothes  
- Medicines  
- Food  
- Documents  
- Groceries  
- Others

5. #  Assignment

This API endpoint is used to assign the request to the courier.  Once the request is processed, the system will assign an AWB number to the shipment, which can be used for tracking the delivery.

## Endpoint : [https://apiv2.shiprocket.in/v1/external/courier/assign/awb](https://apiv2.shiprocket.in/v1/external/courier/assign/awb)

## Method : POST

### **Sample Curl Request**

  curl 	\--location 'https://apiv2.shiprocket.in/v1/external/courier/assign/awb' \\  
\--header 'Content-Type: application/json' \\  
\--header 'Authorization: Bearer {{token}}' \\  
\--data '{  
    	**"shipment\_id": "16090281",**  
	**"future\_pickup\_scheduled": "2025-05-09 08:23:12",**  
	**"vehicle\_type": "3/4”  (default is 2),**  
    	"courier\_id": ""  
}'

### **Request Headers**

* `Content-Type` : `application/json`  
* `Authorization` : `Bearer {{token}}`  
  * Replace `{{token}}` with the actual bearer token received after authentication.

### **Request Parameters**

The request body should be sent in JSON format and must contain the following fields:

| Field | Type | Description | Required |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| shipment\_id | string | The unique identifier for the shipment to which the AWB is to be assigned. | Yes |
| future\_pickup\_scheduled | string | If assignment is planned **within the next 48 hours** from the current time. If the field is empty or null, pickup will be scheduled at the current time. | No |
| courier\_id | string | The unique identifier for the courier service that will handle the shipment. | No |
| vehicle\_type | integer | Indicates mode\_of\_transport: 2/3/4 | In case of 3 or 4 Wheeler |

### **Validation Error Messages of Assignment API**

* ### If the Shipment ID is not provided in the payload, the following error message will be returned

  {  
     "status\_code": 422,  
     "message": "Required field missing",  
     "errors": {  
         "shipment\_id": \[  
             "The shipment ID field is required when Order ID is not present."  
         \],  
         "order\_id": \[  
             "The Order ID field is required when Shipment ID is not present."  
         \]  
     }  
  }  
    
* This error occurs when no courier is serviceable, either because the distance exceeds the hyperlocal limit or the courier service is deactivated on your account  
  {  
     "status\_code": 400,  
     "message": "No Couriers Serviceable Right Now"  
  }  
    
* If you attempt to assign a shipment that is not in the "new" status (e.g., it is already in "searching for rider" or a higher status), you will receive this error message:  
  {  
     "status\_code": 500,  
     "message": "Invalid Status for Hyperlocal Soft Assignment"  
    
  }  
    
* The courier\_id field is optional for hyperlocal shipments. If passed, you will receive the following error:  
  {  
     "status\_code": 500,  
     "message": "Try Assigning Courier via Shiprocket Quick"  
  }  
    
* If your wallet balance is too low, you will receive the following error message:

  {  
     "status\_code": 350,  
     "message": "Please recharge your ShipRocket wallet. The minimum required balance is Rs ?",  
     "awb\_assign\_status": 0,  
     "response": {  
         "data": {  
             "courier\_id": "",  
             "awb\_assign\_error": "Please recharge your ShipRocket wallet. The minimum required balance is Rs ?"  
         }  
     }  
  }  
    
* If you try to assign an AWB using a non-external user token, you will receive this error:  
  {  
     "status\_code": 403,  
     "status": "Failed",  
     "message": "Unauthorized. You don't have permission to perform this action.",  
     "errors": {}  
  }  
    
* If the Shipment ID provided is invalid, the following error will be returned:  
  {  
     "status\_code": 404,  
     "status": "Failed",  
     "message": "Shipment not found",  
     "errors": {}  
  }

### **Example Success Response**

{  
  	"success": true,  
  	"message": "We are processing your request"  
}

### **Response Parameters**

The API response will be in JSON format and may contain the following fields:

| Field | Type | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| success | boolean | Indicates whether the request was successful (true or false). |
| message | string | A message describing the result of the request (e.g., "We are processing your request"). |

6. # Webhooks

Shiprocket allows you to set up a webhook to receive real-time tracking updates for your orders. Once configured, Shiprocket will automatically send a POST request to your specified callback URL whenever a new tracking event occurs for an order.

### **Setup Instructions**

1. **Log in to your Shiprocket account.**  
2. **Navigate to** `Settings > API > Webhooks`.  
3. **Add the webhook URL.**  
4. **Enable the toggle** to activate the webhook.  
5. **Add the security token** (optional, but recommended for enhanced security).

### **Important Considerations:**

* **Webhook URL Restrictions**: Avoid using the following keywords in your webhook URL: `shiprocket`, `kartrocket`, `sr,localhost`,  or `kr`.  
* **Security Token**: The security token to be used is  `x-api-key`. This token is optional but recommended.  
* **Response Code**: The webhook URL should be configured to return an HTTP status code `200` in response to the POST request sent by Shiprocket.

### **Webhook Specifications**

* **Method**: `POST`  
* **Content-Type**: `application/json`  
* **Security Token**: `x-api-key` (optional)

### **Sample Request Body**

When a new tracking event occurs, Shiprocket will send a POST request to your configured webhook URL with a JSON payload. Here’s an example of what the request body might look like:

{  
            "awb": "1724150150",  
            "courier\_name": "Borzo",  
            "current\_status": "RIDER ASSIGNED",  
            "current\_status\_id": 91,  
            "shipment\_status": "RIDER ASSIGNED",  
            "shipment\_status\_id": 79,  
            "shipment\_id": 2344,  
            "current\_timestamp": "20 08 2024 16:06:45",  
            "order\_id": "2000846032",  
            "sr\_order\_id": 141198,  
            "awb\_assigned\_date": "2024-08-20 16:06:23",  
            "pickup\_scheduled\_date": "2024-08-20 16:06:39",  
            "etd": "2024-08-20 17:06:39",  
            "scans": \[\],  
            "is\_return": 0,  
            "channel\_id": 70302,  
            "pod\_status": "",  
            "pod": "Not Available",  
            "delivered\_date": "",  
            "rider\_data": {  
                "rider\_name": "Ram",  
                "rider\_contact": "913421682437",  
                "rider\_lat": 28.509223937988,  
                "rider\_long": 77.067848205566,  
	     "vehicle\_number": "",  
            }  
	"tracking\_url": "https://shiprocket.co/tracking/",  
      "pickup\_otp": "1234",  
      "drop\_otp": "4321"  
 }

### **Headers**

* **Content-Type**: `application/json`  
* **Security Token**: `x-api-key` (if provided)

### **Response**

The webhook callback URL should return an HTTP status code `200 OK` upon successfully receiving the POST request.

### **Webhooks Statuses**

Below are the order statuses you will get in the webhook. 

| current\_status\_id | current\_status | State | Shipment Status ID | Shipment Status | Webhook |
| :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: |
| **1** | **NEW** | **Pre-assignment** | **8** | **CANCELLED** | **Only If shipment gets cancelled post assignment or in case of no assignment** |
| **95** | **SEARCHING FOR RIDER** | **Pre-assignment** | **83** | **SEARCHING FOR RIDER** | **Yes, When assignment is called again post shipment  cancellation** |
| **91** | **RIDER ASSIGNED** | **First Mile** | **79** | **RIDER ASSIGNED** | **Yes** |
| **34** | **OUT FOR PICKUP** | **First Mile** | **19** | **OUT FOR PICKUP** | **Sometimes (Courier dependency)** |
| **93** | **RIDER REACHED PICKUP** | **First Mile** | **81** | **RIDER REACHED AT PICKUP** | **Sometimes (Courier dependency)** |
| **51** | **PICKED UP** | **Last Mile** | **42** | **PICKED UP** | **Yes** |
| **19** | **OUT FOR DELIVERY** | **Last Mile** | **17** | **OUT FOR DELIVERY** | **Sometimes (Courier dependency)** |
| **94** | **RIDER REACHED DROP** | **Last Mile** | **82** | **RIDER REACHED DROP** | **Sometimes (Courier dependency)** |
| **7** | **DELIVERED** | **Last Mile** | **7** | **DELIVERED** | **Yes** |
| **45** | **RTO OFD** | **RTO** | **41** | **RTO OFD** | **Sometimes (Courier dependency)** |
| **55** | **RTO IN TRANSIT** | **Last Mile** | **46** | **RTO IN TRANSIT** | **Sometimes (Courier dependency)** |
| **16** | **RTO DELIVERED** | **Last Mile** | **16** | **RTO DELIVERED** | **Sometimes (Courier dependency)** |
| **5** | **CANCELED** |  | **8** | **CANCELLED** | **Yes** |

### **Notes**

- Ensure that your system is prepared to handle incoming webhook POST requests with a content-type of `application/json`.  
- The security token is optional but adds an extra layer of security by ensuring that the request is coming from Shiprocket.  
- Configure your server to handle and log incoming webhook requests to ensure all tracking updates are processed.

7. #  Cancel Order

This API endpoint is used to cancel one or more orders in the Shiprocket system. By providing the Shiprocket order IDs, you can request the cancellation of those specific orders.

## Endpoint : https://apiv2.shiprocket.in/v1/external/orders/cancel

## Method : POST

### **Sample Curl Request**

curl \--location 'https://apiv2.shiprocket.in/v1/external/orders/cancel' \\  
\--header 'Content-Type: application/json' \\  
\--header 'Authorization: Bearer {{token}}' \\  
\--data '{  
  "ids": \[16168898, 16167171\],  
  "reason": "reason to cancel the order"  
}'

### **Request Headers**

* `Content-Type` : `application/json`  
* `Authorization` : `Bearer {{token}}`  
  * Replace `{{token}}` with the actual bearer token received after authentication.

### **Request Parameters**

| Field | Type | Description | Required |
| ----- | ----- | :---- | ----- |
| ids | *array* | An array of Shiprocket order IDs to be canceled. Each ID should be an integer. | Yes |
| awb\_codes | *array* | An array of AWBs to be canceled.  | Yes |
| reason | *string* | Reason to cancel the order | No |

### **Example Success Response**

{"status\_code":200,"message":"Order cancelled successfully."}

### **Response Parameters**

The API response will be in JSON format and may contain the following fields:

| Field | Type | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| status\_code | *int* | Indicates whether the request was successful (200). |
| message | *string* | A message describing the result of the request (e.g., "Orders have been successfully canceled"). |
